Distribution and host. Labiobulura (A.) peragale is known from a single collection from a locality in central Australia. The host, Macrotis leucrura, is assumed to have become extinct in the 1960 ’ s (Johnson, 2008 a) therefore no further collecting from the type host is possible. There are no records of any species of Labiobulura from the only other extant thylacomid host, Macrotis lagotis (Reid). Given that the conservation status of M. lagotis is vulnerable (Johnson, 2008 b) the potential for finding more specimens of L. peragale, or any related species is limited.
